notes: Phase 5 hardening. Each component has versioned selectors, interaction protocols, and forbidden patterns.

p-calendar.description: PrimeNG date picker — single or range mode

selectors.notes: Icon trigger button. v17=p-datepicker-trigger, v19=p-datepicker-dropdown
Date text input field. Accepts typed dates in MM/DD/YYYY
Day cell in calendar grid. data-date format: YYYY-M-D (M is 0-indexed)
Month navigation buttons

interaction_protocol.notes: Type date directly. Faster than grid navigation

forbidden_patterns: fill() without first opening the calendar — bypasses Angular validation
Using fill() with non-MM/DD/YYYY format — Angular rejects silently
angular_quirks: Wait 500ms after selection for Angular change detection
Calendar panel appends to DOM <body>, not inside the component
In range mode: Tab advances between start and end dates

p-autocomplete.description: PrimeNG autocomplete search field (e.g., Client selector)

selectors.notes: Main text input. MUST use .type() not .fill() — debounce requires slow typing

selectors.name: Client
selectors.notes: Verified from qo_form_basic.test.ts — note trailing space in name
Dropdown option items. Panel appends to <body>

interaction_protocol.notes: Requires minimum 3 characters. Wait 500ms for debounce
Click the matching option. Use .locator('span') if strict mode violation

forbidden_patterns: fill() — executes too fast and completely bypasses the 3-character debounce trigger
type() with less than 3 characters — panel won't appear
angular_quirks: Panel appends to DOM <body>, NOT inside the p-autocomplete element
Heavy debounce (300ms) requires network idle wait
Use getByRole('searchbox', { name: 'Client ' }) then getByRole('option', { name: 'ClientName' }).locator('span')

p-select.description: PrimeNG v19 p-select (replaces p-dropdown in v17)

selectors.notes: Overlay panel selector. OR-chain for v17→v19 compat
Due/Days compound column sort dropdown. Use th-scoped selector
Start/End compound column sort dropdown

interaction_protocol.notes: Use primeng_dropdown macro action — NEVER use individual clicks

forbidden_patterns: p-select#header-sort-drop-down-duedaysCol — inputId is on the inner <input>, NOT the <p-select> host
Clicking the trigger twice without selecting an option — toggle loop
:has-text() pseudo-class — not supported in Playwright CSS selectors
get_by_role('combobox') without container scoping — matches multiple
angular_quirks: Overlay closes immediately on selection (<50ms)
element_visible on .p-select-overlay always fails — auto-satisfied by verifier
Use th-scoped selectors: th.po-col-duedaysCol p-select

p-table.description: PrimeNG data table (Production Orders, MyBox, etc.)

selectors.notes: Loading spinner selectors — wait for hidden
CLIENT column header for sorting
STATUS/TASKS column header for sorting
Next page button in paginator

interaction_protocol.notes: Always wait for loading to finish before interacting
Click client name to open order. NEVER use get_by_role('link')

forbidden_patterns: scroll action — tables use PrimeNG virtual pagination, scrolling won't reveal more rows
get_by_role('link') for table rows — Angular doesn't expose ARIA link roles
verify action for sort order — use verify_table_sort instead
Clicking column header >2 times without verify_table_sort in between
angular_quirks: Data loads asynchronously — always wait for loading overlays
Sort cycles: click 1 = ascending, click 2 = descending, click 3 = unsorted
Do NOT include sort icons (pi-sort-up, pi-sort-down) in locator names

selectors.notes: Toast container. Appears within 100ms, disappears after ~3s
Toast text content — summary and detail lines

angular_quirks: Toasts disappear quickly (~3s). Verify immediately after trigger action
Use transient_page_text cache before attempting DOM lookup

selectors.notes: Hidden file input — use set_input_files, NEVER click Browse

interaction_protocol.notes: Upload file via hidden input. Wait 1000ms for Angular processing

forbidden_patterns: click() on Browse/Upload/Choose File buttons — triggers native OS dialog
Direct interaction with the file input's visible trigger button
angular_quirks: Never click Browse — use setInputFiles on the hidden input
After upload: wait 1000ms, then select File Type from p-dropdown
Multiple file uploads may require sequential setInputFiles calls

p-multiselect.description: PrimeNG multi-select dropdown — allows selecting multiple options

selectors.notes: Open trigger button and label container
Individual selectable option items in the panel
Close button to dismiss the panel

interaction_protocol.notes: Click trigger to open panel. Wait 300ms for animation.
MUST close panel after selecting options

forbidden_patterns: select_option() — this is a custom div structure, not a native <select>
Leaving the panel open after selecting options — it covers the screen and blocks subsequent clicks
angular_quirks: Panel appends to body
MUST explicitly close the panel after selecting options, otherwise it covers the screen and blocks subsequent clicks

selectors.notes: Visual checkbox element to click. Native input is hidden.

interaction_protocol.notes: Click the visual .p-checkbox-box element to toggle

forbidden_patterns: check() or uncheck() — Playwright native methods fail because the input is visually hidden. Must click the visual .p-checkbox-box element
Clicking the native <input type='checkbox'> — it is visually hidden and throws 'element intercepted' in Playwright
angular_quirks: The native <input> is hidden. Click the .p-checkbox-box visual element instead
Check state: look for .p-highlight class on .p-checkbox-box

selectors.notes: Modal container. Wait for visible before interacting.
Confirm/Yes button
Reject/No button

interaction_protocol.notes: Wait for dialog to appear and animate in before clicking

forbidden_patterns: Clicking outside the dialog to dismiss — focus is trapped, this does nothing
Using button text 'Yes'/'No' with get_by_role without the .p-confirm-dialog-accept scoping — risks matching other dialogs
angular_quirks: Modal appends to body. Focus is trapped inside until resolved — blocks all other UI interactions
Wait 350ms after the trigger click before asserting button visibility inside the dialog

p-tablecheckbox.description: PrimeNG p-tablecheckbox — row selection checkbox inside a p-table

selectors.notes: Toggle individual row selection
First row checkbox
Visual checkbox box inside table rows

interaction_protocol.notes: Click p-tablecheckbox to toggle row selection

forbidden_patterns: check() / uncheck() — Playwright native methods fail on PrimeNG table checkboxes
getByRole('checkbox') — the native checkbox is hidden and not interactive
p-checkbox:has-text('Select All') — :has-text() pseudo-class is not supported in Playwright CSS selectors
angular_quirks: Custom component — use click(), not check(). The native checkbox is hidden
For Select All: target th .p-checkbox-box (the header checkbox), not a standalone p-checkbox text selector

p-table-header.description: PrimeNG p-table column header — sortable column headers with dropdown sub-menus for compound columns

selectors.notes: Use ONLY clean column label text — do NOT include sort icons or arrow characters

interaction_protocol.notes: Click column header then wait 1000ms for sort re-render
Always verify with verify_table_sort, never a standard verify action

forbidden_patterns: Using a standard verify action to visually check sort order — causes infinite loops
Including 'pi-sort-up' or 'pi-sort-down' or arrow characters in get_by_role column header name — these are dynamic and cause locator failures
Clicking the column header more than 2 times without a verify_table_sort in between
angular_quirks: Do not include sort icons in the locator name. Target clean column text only
Wait 1000ms after clicking a header for Angular to re-render sorted data
Sort cycles: first click=ascending, second=descending, third=unsorted. Track click count
Some headers (Due/Days, Start/End) are compound columns — clicking opens a dropdown sub-menu, NOT a direct sort
